packageRules.description: @weavesmith/core must stay dependency-free. Renovate should never add one, and any devDependency change there needs a human look.
Group the React toolchain — React, its types and the Vite plugin move together and are pointless to review one at a time.
Group the test toolchain for the same reason.
Node and pnpm floors are declared in engines and asserted by CI; bump them deliberately, not automatically.
